args: const fs=require('node:fs'); const os=require('node:os'); const path=require('node:path'); const {pathToFileURL}=require('node:url'); const home=process.env.CODEX_HOME||path.join(os.homedir(),'.codex'); const root=path.join(home,'plugins','cache','agents-comm-bus-codex','matrix'); const versions=fs.existsSync(root)?fs.readdirSync(root,{withFileTypes:true}).filter((entry)=>entry.isDirectory()).map((entry)=>entry.name).sort((a,b)=>a.localeCompare(b,undefined,{numeric:true})):[]; const dir=versions.reverse().map((version)=>path.join(root,version)).find((candidate)=>fs.existsSync(path.join(candidate,'codex-mcp-shim.js'))); if(!dir){console.error('[acb-mcp] unable to locate installed matrix plugin shim under '+root);process.exit(1);} import(pathToFileURL(path.join(dir,'codex-mcp-shim.js')).href).catch((error)=>{console.error(error);process.exit(1);});
